qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Transamerica operates in highly competitive US life and retirement markets where products are commoditized, distribution is intermediated, and in-force life/annuity contracts have zero ability to raise prices above inflation. Multi-cycle ROE and ROIC remain far below 12%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & zero pricing power, REJECT). Capital-intensive US life and retirement insurer (Transamerica) with an extensive multi-decade history of sub-hurdle returns on capital, legacy liability de-risking, and zero pricing power over in-force policies.
qualitative.evidence: Aegon divested its domestic Dutch insurance operations to aSR and re-centered on US Transamerica. 10-year average ROE tracks in the mid-single digits (4-8%), failing the 12% hurdle. Life insurance liabilities cannot reprice to inflation, leaving earnings vulnerable to spread compression, reserve adjustments, and equity market fluctuations.
